zhengOperationControl.sourceSpecialTuningException: The Chinese caption explicitly excepts special tunings (特殊定弦例外). This local operation is applied only to the printed open-string configuration.

simultaneousCounterexample.proof: Both values have the same singleton owner {string1}. One string cannot hold two bridge settings simultaneously. Other strings cannot supply either value in the stated local ±1 domain.
